niche.habitat: 2.8–3.5 km depth, stagnant high-brine porosity near 100–115°C
niche.diet: Microbial colonies, stored O2-burst attacks, mineral particulates
niche.active: Episodic, triggered by chemical gradients or pressure shifts

body: Spherical/ovoid, spiny exoskeleton, internal clathrate reservoirs

chains.trait: Internal methane clathrate reservoirs control buoyancy
links: Neutral buoyancy requires precise volume displacement
Calcium chloride saturation stabilizes heavy fluid

skill.effect: Ascends 5m instantly by dissociating bladder, costs stamina

chains.weakness: Violent bubble release alerts prey and scavengers
observe: Rapid ascent leaves trailing ice crystals

journal.en: They carry their own ice to ride the dark.

chains.trait: Radiolytic oxygen burst organs deliver one-shot attacks
links: Strict anaerobes cannot tolerate free O2 long-term
Radiolysis hoards H2 and O2 in same pore
Metabolic explosion poisons cell after one use

skill.effect: Deals 30 damage burst, then 2-turn stun as cell detoxifies

chains.weakness: Leaves them metabolically inactive until detox complete
observe: Gill slits vent pale vapor post-attack
Muscle fibers contract in violent spasms
Skin flushed red, then grey as O2 clears

analogues.mechanism: see the cited works; chain wording is the council's own

links: Protein denaturation sets hard ceiling near 122°C
Repair mechanisms fail above thermal limit
Local isotherm lies at about 4km depth

skill.effect: Reduces thermal damage by 40% and slows decay

chains.weakness: Carapace limits flexibility in narrow cracks
observe: Spines arranged in insulating air pockets
Metabolic rate drops as temperature rises

journal.en: They wear the crust’s fever as armor.

analogues.mechanism: see the cited works; chain wording is the council's own

chains.trait: Seismic vibration receptors hunt via low-frequency tremors
links: Chemical diffusion moves scent only 1 cm/day
Sound travels 3000 m/s in solid rock
Fracture networks act as planetary acoustic waveguides

skill.effect: Reveals hidden creatures in adjacent tiles within 3m

chains.weakness: Deaf to high-frequency vibrations and sudden cracks
observe: Antennae quiver to distant tectonic shifts

journal.en: They listen to the world’s heartbeat.

secrets: If you cool their bladder with fresh ice chips, they become harmless and docile for a turn.
Their spines can be harvested to craft heat-resistant gear.
moments: When it strikes, the brine boils around it for three seconds, then goes still as the oxygen dies in its own veins.

journal.en: They are the planet’s sudden thought.
Warmth is a weapon, and a cage.
